decisions.decision: Primary Merchant/Storefront channel has zero LetBuyy sales commission for every storefront merchant.
Marketplace has a dedicated Seller application over the shared canonical backend/database.
Same-business products can be enabled bidirectionally between Merchant and Seller, using canonical identities and truly shared physical stock.
Channel-specific products, publication, pricing, approvals and fees remain possible.
Dedicated preserved Store Ops and existing Delivery source are reused for Quick.
Same person may use every approved app through the canonical issuer, with scoped relationships and permissions.
Retain one existing customer app with Marketplace and Quick native modes.
Research includes independent franchises and supermarket partnerships; online and COD and broad category classes remain intended.
Two-brand direction: LetBuyy and a compatible consumer brand such as LetKart.
Only this research chat resumed; all other LetBuyy chats remain paused.
LetBuyy merchant platform and LetKart consumer/Seller/Partner Ops/Delivery brand assignment, subject to clearance.
Supermarket-owned-stock pilot before broad dedicated-franchise recruitment.
One primary variable fee per actual Quick service; complete partner economics before rate activation.
Exact pilot city/sites/SKUs/hours, current provider eligibility, approved rates and partner responsibility agreements.
Align scoped app topology/source promotion and storefront-zero/Marketplace-category commercial governance before activation; no amendment signature fabricated.
Use instant as the single persisted/wire Quick channel and sales origin, extending current two-origin contracts end to end after P0/P2 admission; do not create competing quick and instant meanings.
Owner reports ownership of letbuyy.com and letbuyy.store; no other brand domain is assumed owned.

Keep LetBuyy for the existing customer Marketplace and storefront platform; use LetBuyy Store and LetBuyy Seller. LetKart Quick is a candidate Quick brand inside the existing customer app; name clearance remains open.
Admit apps/seller/mobile, apps/quick/store-ops/mobile and apps/quick/delivery/mobile as source-promotion destinations before any moves; retain other existing roots.

Include Marketplace customer web at proposed apps/marketplace/web and Store Ops web at proposed apps/quick/store-ops/web, sharing canonical backend/database/issuer. This supersedes the earlier plan omitting those web apps; Seller web is not added by this request.
